sections.heading: IEC 60601-2-19
paragraphs: At ITC India (www.itcindia.org), based in Mohali, we offer advanced, IEC-compliant testing services for neonatal incubators, transport incubators, and radiant warmers. Our NABL‑accredited laboratory ensures every device meets international quality and safety benchmarks.

sections.heading: 🔍 Why Testing Matters
paragraphs: Infant incubators create a controlled warm and humid environment vital for premature and vulnerable newbornsen.wikipedia.org+12itcindia.org+12flukebiomedical.com+12. A single malfunction—such as overheating, poor humidity, or air-flow issues—can severely compromise infant health. Routine testing protects lives, ensures equipment reliability, and extends service life.

sections.heading: Key Testing Areas
bullets: Electrical Safety & Dielectric Strength Grounding checks, leakage current, and insulation testing, including targeted 4 kV dielectric assessments—ensuring integrity of heaters and critical wiring.
Temperature Performance Calibration of control mechanisms, overshoot limits (≤2 °C), and stabilization tests sustained over 60 minutesmedicalexpo.com+4andarint.com+4array.aami.org+4.
Humidity Regulation Accuracy within ±10 %, crucial for respiratory careandarint.com+1en.wikipedia.org+1.
Airflow Uniformity Measurement at five critical points, ≤0.35 m/s, ensuring consistent thermal environmentandarint.com.
Noise Levels & Alarms Internal sound levels <60 dBA with validated audibility and alarm trigger thresholdsandarint.com+1flukebiomedical.com+1.
Oxygen Concentration & Weighing Modules Precise calibration of oxygen sensors and weighing scales in transport unitsitcindia.org+10andarint.com+10itcindia.org+10.
